timeout.recommendation: Add 5000ms timeout to HTTP client for HIBP API calls

retry.recommendation: Add single retry with 1s backoff for transient network errors

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Add circuit breaker to prevent cascading failures when HIBP is down

fallback.behavior: Error is logged but password check failure is propagated as 400 error
fallback.recommendation: Consider allowing password when HIBP is unreachable (fail-open for availability)

idempotency.reason: Read-only API call, safe to retry

blast_radius.impact: Admin cannot update user passwords when HIBP API is down (if PASSWORD_CHECK_PWN enabled)

findings.detail: No timeout on HIBP API call
findings.recommendation: Add context timeout for external call

non_atomic_operations: Email replacement (delete old + insert new) is in transaction, but auth update and profile update are separate operations
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: HIBP API down blocks password updates

findings.detail: Purge mode performs multi-step operations (disable user, delete repos, delete orgs) outside transaction
findings.recommendation: Acceptable design - each step is independently consistent

non_atomic_operations: Purge: disable user → delete repos → remove from orgs → delete user (each step outside main transaction)
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: Partial purge could leave orphaned data if process crashes mid-way
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: User is disabled first, preventing further actions even if purge fails

findings.detail: Key deletion and authorized_keys rewrite are separate operations
findings.recommendation: If rewrite fails, key is deleted from DB but still in authorized_keys file until next rewrite

non_atomic_operations: Delete key from DB then rewrite authorized_keys file

findings.detail: DB transaction commits then filesystem rename happens; if rename fails, rollback is attempted
findings.recommendation: Current rollback logic is adequate but could leave inconsistent state on double failure

non_atomic_operations: DB transaction (update repos, create redirect, update user) then filesystem directory rename
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: If filesystem rename fails after DB commit, rollback is attempted but could fail
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Rollback logic attempts to restore old directory name

graceful_shutdown.detail: Graceful shutdown via modules/graceful package handles SIGTERM

rate_limiting.detail: No built-in rate limiting on API endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware or use reverse proxy rate limiting

single_points_of_failure: HaveIBeenPwned API for password validation (when enabled)
cascading_failure_paths: HIBP API down → ep-099 password updates fail (when PASSWORD_CHECK_PWN enabled)
